hazards.control: Pressure test before opening to the well; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.

name: Upper master valve
function: The working master valve, cycled to shut the well in; hydraulic with a surface safety system on some trees.

tabs.overview: Manual on this tree; a hydraulic actuator with a fail-closed spring makes it a surface safety valve where required.
tabs.safety: The valve used for routine shut-ins so the lower master stays fresh.
tabs.evidence: API 6A scope for trees (S1), API Spec 14A for safety valves (S29), API 11D1 for packers (S21), field practice (S9). Photographs read for proportion only.
